SS 304 Railings, Temple Gates & Steel Work in Janakpur

Murli Chowk (Airport Road), Janakpur Dham-8, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal · Open 7 days · Google Maps

Janakpur is a temple city. Gates and railings here are not only security — they are the first thing pilgrims and wedding guests see. Annapurna Aluminium & UPVC fabricates SS 304 temple gates, staircase pillars, balcony guards and MS compound gates at Murli Chowk, then installs them from Duhaba to Dhanushadham.

Steel work we are known for

  • Temple and math gates — arched SS double leaves, laser-cut jaali, religious sunburst, nameboard in Devanagari.
  • SS 304 stair and balcony railings — mirror pipe, crystal acrylic posts, wave and sunburst balusters.
  • MS sliding and swing compound gates for private houses on Airport Road and farm plots toward Nagarain.
  • Window grills, security doors, pergolas, parking sheds and rooftop guard rails.

Cheap SS 202 rusts at the weld within one Janakpur monsoon. We specify 304, show you a magnet test on request, and polish after TIG so the bead itself is a mirror. Hybrid gates (MS box frame + SS tubes) keep cost honest on long compound openings without looking rural.

नेपालीमा

जनकपुरधाम र धनुषाका मन्दिर, घर र कम्पाउण्डका लागि एसएस ३०४ रेलिङ र मन्दिर गेट मुरली चोकमा टिग वेल्ड र मिरर पालिसमा बन्छ। श्री नव दुर्गा मन्दिर दुहबाको गेट हाम्रै काम हो। खिया नलाग्ने ग्यारेन्टी — ह्वाट्सएप +९७७ ९८१७६५८७१९।

Questions from Janakpur clients

Do you fabricate temple gates in Dhanusha?

Yes. We built the ceremonial SS 304 double gate for Sri Nav Durga Mandir Duhaba and take similar temple, math and dharamshala work across Dhanusha and Mahottari — sunburst motifs, Devanagari nameplates and heavy ball-bearing hinges.

What steel grade do you use for outdoor railings in Janakpur?

Genuine SS 304 with nickel content, argon TIG welding and diamond-compound mirror polish. We do not pass SS 202 as 304. Outdoor balcony and stair railings stay bright through the monsoon.
